meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to come back, to return', paired with 'возвращаться'.

examples.text: Так, не шумим. Я скоро вернусь.
examples.trans: Right, no noise. I'll be back soon.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

вытащить.gloss: to pull out, to get out

meanings.en: to pull out, to take out
meanings.note: вытащить из сумки = to take out of a bag

Of trouble, of prison. Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'тащить'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to pull out, to get out', paired with 'вытаскивать'.

examples.text: Я буду мэром вместо него, чтобы его потом вытащить.
examples.trans: I'll be mayor instead of him, so I can get him out later.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'сделать'.
Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'сделать'.

examples.trans: Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

держаться.gloss: to hold on; to stick with

meanings.note: за + accusative: держись за руку = hold on to my hand

meanings.en: to stick with, keep close to
meanings.note: + genitive: держитесь меня = stick with me

Держись! = hang in there!. Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to hold on; to stick with'.

examples.text: Держитесь меня, и всё будет хорошо.
examples.trans: Stick with me and everything will be fine.

examples.text: Держитесь меня, и всё у вас будет хорошо. Потому что я кто?
examples.trans: Stick with me, and everything will be fine for you. Because who am I?

meanings.note: irregular feminine declension with stem дочер-

examples.text: Простите, это собака дочери. Я с ней гуляю пока.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'to her', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

meanings.en: to answer, to reply, to pick up the phone
meanings.note: Отвечать кому / на звонок. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to answer, to reply', paired with 'ответить'.

examples.text: Я вам звоню, а вы не отвечаете!
examples.trans: I call you, and you don't answer!

examples.text: Почему ты не отвечаешь на мои вопросы?
examples.trans: Why aren't you answering my questions?

отойти.gloss: to step back, to move away

meanings.en: to step aside, to move back
meanings.note: Perfective of отходить. Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to step back, to move away', paired with 'отходить'.

examples.trans: He stepped over to the window.

meanings.en: to have a talk, to speak (with someone)
meanings.note: Поговорить с + instrumental. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'говорить'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to have a talk', paired with 'говорить'.

examples.text: Поговори с Аракеляном. Пусть он заберёт заявление.
examples.trans: Talk to Arakelyan. Get him to withdraw his statement.

meanings.note: Informal. Core Russian interj meaning 'bye' in everyday speech.

Deliberate act of a person. Common masculine noun meaning 'act, action, deed' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: I committed a very foolish act.

examples.trans: It was a noble and brave deed.

examples.text: Соколов, не делай сейчас таких глупых поступков.

meanings.note: In потому что.

meanings.note: Asks about the reason.

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

meanings.en: to warn, to give advance notice
meanings.note: Prefix 'пред-' ('before, fore-') indicates anticipation or prior position (stem 'упреждать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to warn', paired with 'предупредить'.

examples.trans: I am warning you for the last time.

examples.text: О чём предупреждал? Да ты что делаешь?

meanings.note: On foot, once. Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to come, to arrive', paired with 'приходить'.

examples.trans: Don't, Samson. Security will be here any second.

Imperative: прости / простите. Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to forgive; (imperative) excuse me', paired with 'прощать'.
